name: Alpico Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Alpico Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in distribution in Japan through Distribution, Transportation, Tourism, Real Estate and Other Service segments. It runs food supermarkets under the Delicia brand, commercial product stores such as Gyomu Super, mobile sales vehicles, online supermarkets and pharmacies, along with real estate rental, villa management and insurance activities. Dating from 1920, it has its headquarters in Matsumoto, Japan.
